sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Gladiator Life - Part 4 is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov Arena.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "Looks like you're picking up the basics just fine. Not like some... ah, forget about the others. Let's focus on you. What matters now is winning. So come on, grab your weapon and get out there. Time to take the Arena by storm!"

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text: - Win a match in CheckPoint mode

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +2,800 EXP
- 37,500 Roubles
- 10 GP coins
- Unlocks SIG MPX 9x19 submachine gun in the Armory
- Unlocks FDE weapon camouflage
